verdict.rationale: ROCm docs describe full-stack documentation and recipes for deploying AI workloads with 'popular ROCm-enabled frameworks', with dedicated vLLM and SGLang inference guides. A community benchmark shows real decode throughput numbers on MI355X, which corroborates that mainstream inference stacks run on it. However, the pack never names PyTorch explicitly and shows no MI355X-specific support matrix or officially versioned framework builds. Missing for 10: explicit PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX build documentation, a published framework/OS/GPU support matrix covering MI355X, training-framework coverage.
